subject.title: fix(reef): repeated relay reconnects no longer leave stale sockets active

question: Should Reef force-terminate an unresponsive inbox WebSocket after five seconds, while still waiting for its real close event before reconnecting?
rationale: The patch’s correctness evidence supports its ordering invariant, but the chosen timeout and abrupt termination behavior are an operational availability policy that source review cannot select on behalf of the channel owner.

options.title: Accept bounded forced close
options.body: Keep the five-second termination fallback so an unresponsive relay cannot indefinitely stall reconnect, while retaining the close-event wait before replacement.

options.title: Choose a different recovery policy
options.body: Specify a different timeout or relay-recovery contract, then revise the transport and focused proof to match that owner-approved policy.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded forced close
recommendation.body: Keep the five-second termination fallback so an unresponsive relay cannot indefinitely stall reconnect, while retaining the close-event wait before replacement.
